title: Stopped runtime fallbacks from replacing valid model output
points: Valid non-empty Router plans now remain authoritative after structural validation; regex recovery runs only when no executable plan or compute intent exists.
Narrative pages that were retrieved but never validly submitted remain trace diagnostics and are no longer promoted into AnalystContext evidence.
Missing analyst source or table selections now trigger one model-authored corrective retry instead of exposing every available source and attachment.
Runtime collision evals now reject unallowlisted high-risk interventions, evaluate their expectation contracts, and replay the exact same captured Router plan during ablation.
Bank individual-deposit retrieval and market-wide deterministic screen routing now live in their prompt and stage contracts instead of post-Router plan rewrites.
